slides.title: Most applications ended after round one.
slides.sub: Then Kami worked with Jordan. Here's what changed, in Kami's own words.

slides.quote: I've applied for a lot of roles on my own, and most ended after the first round. Working with Jordan was different.
slides.name: Kami Ho

slides.quote: He brought me a role at Reya Labs before it was public and stayed close through all four interview rounds. Before each call, he gave me background on the company and the people I'd meet.
slides.name: Kami Ho

slides.quote: When I doubted myself before the technical round, he told me my work was what they were looking for. That helped more than he knows. I'm now on the team full time.
slides.name: Kami Ho

slides.title: Designer or engineer in crypto?
slides.sub: "If you're a designer or engineer looking at crypto or trading roles, talk to Jordan."
